narrative.summary: The GCC's published AI instrument is the Guiding Manual on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2025), an advisory manual prepared by GCC ministerial and judicial committees and published by the Secretariat General. The GCC Secretariat has also announced general frameworks on AI in public services and on AI for climate forecasting and disaster management, and is preparing a unified Gulf guiding AI strategy; these texts have not been published.

instruments.current_status: Published by the GCC Secretariat General in 2025 as a guiding (advisory) manual. Bahrain's Information & eGovernment Authority announced its adoption on 27 July 2025.
instruments.scope: Ethical use of artificial intelligence by users of the technology in GCC Member States, including government and judicial work.
instruments.summary: Guiding manual on the ethical use of artificial intelligence, prepared jointly by the GCC committee of heads of supreme and cassation courts and the Ministerial Committee for eGovernment and published by the GCC Secretariat General. It is advisory and is intended as a reference for all users of AI in Member States. Bahrain announced its adoption in July 2025.

Bahrain adoption: iGA news 'Bahrain Launches National AI Policy and Adopts GCC Ethics Manual', 27 Jul 2025 (https://www.iga.gov.bh/en/article/bahrain-launches-national-ai-policy-and-adopts-gcc-ethics-manual), which names the issuer as the Ministerial Committee for eGovernment of the GCC. | Research pass 2026-10-21: Existing record kept. leads.title: Final Statement of the Supreme Council, 46th session (3 December 2025), para. 18
leads.note: Supreme Council reviewed the Advisory Commission's views on, among other topics, unified policies and legislation for the use of AI; a single clause in a general communiqué, and the Advisory Commission's views are not published.

leads.title: Kuwait Declaration, 45th session of the Supreme Council (1 December 2024)
leads.note: Declaration centred on the digital economy; AI appears only within a list of IT fields for investment, so not a dedicated AI commitment.

leads.title: Gulf strategy to combat cybercrime and AI crimes (الاستراتيجية الخليجية لمكافحة الجرائم الإلكترونية وجرائم الذكاء الاصطناعي)

leads.title: GCC eLearning Officials Committee: adoption of Saudi NeLC AI strategic directions as a reference model (24th meeting, 5 Nov 2025)

leads.title: GCC Standardization Organization (GSO) adoptions of ISO/IEC AI standards (e.g. GSO ISO/IEC 22989:2024, 42001:2025, 23894:2025)
leads.note: GSO is a separate GCC specialised standards body (membership includes Yemen); these are identical adoptions of ISO/IEC standards, not GCC-authored texts. Consider only if GSO is treated as its own entry.
